queries_run: Deckers UGG Hoka competition substitute alternative footwear threat 2026
UGG sheepskin alternative materials competitors dupes Hoka market share On Running 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：部分競爭者在財務、技術、製造、行銷與通路資源上遠大於 Deckers，能更快加速產品開發、運用數據分析或 AI、適應技術變化；Deckers 亦稱無法保證能成功適應技術變化。
findings.excerpt: Some of our competitors also have substantially greater financial, technological, manufacturing, marketing, and distribution resources than we do, as well as broader brand awareness, which may enable them to compete more effectively on price, accelerate product development, leverage advanced data analytics or AI, adapt to technological changes, and withstand periods of excess inventory or reduced consumer demand.

findings.claim: 搜尋未找到 UGG 羊皮的替代材料或「平替」威脅的來源；10-K 僅提到替代材料不含同樣商標。
findings.excerpt: Although alternative materials may be available for certain branded components, which may be limited, such alternatives would not include the same trademarks.

findings.claim: Bernstein 給 Deckers Underperform、目標價 $100：稱 Hoka 緩衝技術已被競品複製、On 持續取得市占、Nike 跑鞋回歸構成威脅，UGG 休閒品類緩慢萎縮。
findings.source: Tiger Brokers 轉載 Bernstein 報告
findings.excerpt: Looking at the challenges facing each brand, Hoka's superior cushioning technology has been replicated by competitors, while retailers are showing fatigue with the trend. Nike's strong comeback in the running shoe segment poses a threat with its more diverse product lineup, while On continues to gain market share.

note: Bernstein 看空報告（Hoka 緩衝技術被複製、On 持續搶市占、Nike 跑鞋回歸、UGG 休閒品類萎縮）僅取得搜尋摘要轉述、無逐字原文，發布日未確認，列為線索。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
